entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Style/medium: crisp hand-authored pixel art with clean readable colour clusters and a
cozy illustrated 16-bit adventure-game finish; flat fills with a two-step shading ramp
per material; a one-pixel dark warm outline on exterior silhouettes and on overlaps
only, never pure black; no interior outlining of fine detail; original design.
Composition/framing: exact straight-on eye-level view, no perspective tilt, no
top-down angle, no vanishing-point recession; every subject upright and centred in
its own cell with generous even padding.
Lighting/mood: a single soft light source from the upper left; warm domestic daylight;
calm, tidy, quietly cheerful; the mood of a well-kept windowsill in an ordinary home.
Color palette: warm walnut and honey wood, matte terracotta orange, warm cream, deep
teal glaze, charcoal grey, and above all MUTED WARM OLIVE-LEANING GREENS - desaturated
sage, olive and moss, never bright spring green, never neon, never emerald.
Constraints: no text, letters, numerals, signage, labels, logos, watermarks, borders,
frames, panels, UI, drop shadows, cast shadows, contact shadows, outer glows, or
reflections; no human or animal figures; no faces or eyes on any plant or object;
subject only.
Avoid: photorealism, photography, 3D render, glossy specular highlights, airbrush
gradients, soft focus, painterly brush texture, visible canvas grain, anime or manga
rendering, sticker die-cut outlines, isometric projection, cluttered scene dressing.
Asset type: a four-cell horizontal growth strip of a single houseplant for a
terminal-native pixel-art game, 16:9 canvas.
Primary request: Create an original golden pothos with heart-shaped leaves and gold variegation rendered as the same individual
plant at four ages, arranged left to right in one row.
Sheet layout: exactly four plants in a single horizontal row, evenly spaced, each in
its own quarter of the canvas, all standing on one shared invisible ground line at the
bottom, all drawn at the SAME SCALE so the size difference between them is real and
readable. Left to right: (1) a very young newly potted plant, roughly one quarter the
height of the fourth; (2) a young growing plant, roughly half the height of the fourth;
(3) a full mature plant; (4) an overgrown crowded specimen of the same height as the
third but visibly denser, with more leaves and a crowded crown.
Subject: the above-soil part of the plant ONLY - leaves, petioles and stems. NO POT,
NO CONTAINER, NO SOIL, NO SOIL SURFACE, NO ROOTS, NO GROUND, NO TABLE, NO SURFACE.
Each plant's stems simply continue straight down and are cut off flat at the very
bottom edge of the canvas.
Subject state: peak health: glossy taut heart-shaped leaves, gold variegation at maximum contrast, one bright pale-green leaf unfurling at the tip of each plant
Background: one perfectly flat, solid, uniform #ff00ff background filling the entire
canvas edge to edge behind and between all four plants, with no gradient, no texture,
no vignette and no shading; do NOT use magenta, pink, or purple anywhere in the subject.
